Separately, the record's cuisine string reads 「有機野菜・ベジタリアン・グルテンフリー対応」 — no source anywhere (site, Tabelog, Gnavi, Visit Chiyoda, san-tatsu) uses the words グルテンフリー about this shop; drop that from the cuisine label.

note: TRADING — open (site posting branch notices dated 2026-08-19; 新宿 branch listed on /shop/; pin is within ~300 m of it). The two tier values are CORRECT: gf_confidence 'no' and vegan_status 'no' are exactly right for a shop that declares 小麦 and 豚肉 and refuses per-ingredient disclosure. The defect is that the record's CATEGORY defeats them. Because category is 'VEGAN', the app's fullVeg test treats this pork-and-miso ramen chain as fully vegan, so it surfaces with the vegan dial set to 1 (Full only) and in Group/Leader mode — the exact 'vegan: full on a venue serving meat' failure in the brief, arriving through the category field instead of the status field. Nothing on the official site uses the word ヴィーガン. Set category to a non-vegan value and delete 「ヴィーガン対応」 from the cuisine string. THIS IS NOT A ONE-RECORD BUG: 102 records app-wide carry category VEGAN or SHOJIN with vegan_status below 'full' (68 options, 29 ask, 3 limited, 2 no), and every one of them is promoted to fully-vegan by that same line.
